name: terminal-simulator
title: Terminal Simulator
description: Editor and terminal mock for vertical reels: a dark brand window with a file list, code lines that draw in one by one and a render command that rises in the terminal pane. Brand palette, monospace 28 px for code, sized for the 780 px graphics field. Mount it with data-composition-src on a host with data-composition-id="terminal-simulator", once for each place it plays.
